purpose: exact protocol comparison R7 vs earlier successful R4/R5 and failed R6

input: 老子 道德經 註解 學說

task_encoding.all: no task/prefix/instruction wrapper; raw query text as single input element

http_client.all: same product class OpenAICompatEmbeddingBackend (urllib.request.urlopen, no ProxyHandler/getproxies)

proxy_env.r4_r5_r6_r7: no *_proxy environment variables set; no proxy code; git http.proxy unset

endpoint_model_state_r7.note: sleep-idle-seconds -1 disables idle auto-unload; model not unloaded by idle at R7

conclusion_from_comparison.protocol_route_model_encoding_content_ty: identical across R4/R5/R6/R7; not the differentiator
conclusion_from_comparison.deterministic_difference_r6_vs_r4_r5: R6 used a 30s text/cold timeout versus R4/R5's 90s; R6's request was byte-identical in shape
conclusion_from_comparison.r7_outcome: with the R4/R5 90s budget the SAME request succeeded in 0.022-0.061s; the endpoint was warm/fast at R7 time
conclusion_from_comparison.inference: R6's 30s timeout was NOT because the endpoint needs >30s under normal (warm) conditions; it reflects a transient endpoint state at R6 time (busy/queued/stuck) that had cleared by R7
